system.axeLine: Haah… This is really testing my temper, isn't it?
system.bulletLine: Dahrk Wander… sigh… One shot, please.

hyean.name: Diana's Insight

rewind.name: Renewa's Rewind
rewind.desc: Once, when the kingdom falls, time turns back a little.

bullet.name: Black Bullet
bullet.desc: Smashes a document with no side effects, even the elves' and witches' ones.

stitch.name: Chloe's Stitch
stitch.desc: Once, it stitches a collapsing gauge and stops it.

alice.name: Wild Card
alice.desc: Swaps one ordinary document for another.

blindfold.name: Magic Blindfold
blindfold.desc: The gauge it covers will not change for the next document.

scope.name: Bullet Scope
scope.desc: Takes aim at a document: what would hurt shrinks, what would help grows.

understudy.name: Understudy
understudy.desc: When a gauge would turn dangerous, the change is softened a little.

bandage.name: All-Purpose Bandage
bandage.desc: Stick it on one resource to pull it back toward the middle.

system.aliceLine: The card whispers: 'Shall I swap this document for another?'

lines.name: Renewa
lines.text: It can't be helped. Right now, it can still be undone. With my power, I can turn time back five years. But only once.

lines.name: Renewa
lines.text: It isn't over yet. I'll help you as far as I possibly can. Let's go back a little. But only once.

lines.name: Speaki
lines.text: S… Speaki doesn't think she did anything that bad…

lines.name: Speaki
lines.text: Hehe~ While Ner was stamping a fake document, Ner gave today's sermooon!

lines.name: Chloe
lines.text: Huh? It's torn here. Hold still, Head Priestess. …Done. One stitch is enough.

lines.name: Ner
lines.text: …I owe you one, Chloe. Let me buy you a knot roll at least.

lines.name: Erpin
lines.text: Ner! Take my hand! You can't fall here!

lines.name: Ner
lines.text: …Hah, hah. Yes, Your Majesty. This isn't the time to fall.

lines.name: Erpin
lines.text: Ner, I stamped everything really hard for you! If you're sleepy, tell me first. …I did good, so I get candy, right?

lines.name: Erpin
lines.text: Huh? Ner, are you asleep? …Okay, I'll help in your place! Um… I just stamp whatever, right?

sugar_low.title: The Sugar Riot
sugar_low.text: With the candy stores empty, starving fairies break down the warehouse doors. Fights break out over the last candy crumbs, and order in the kingdom collapses.

sugar_high.title: Candy Addiction
sugar_high.text: Candy overflows in every corner of the kingdom, and the fairies wander around dazed all day with sweets in their mouths. Even Erpin has fallen asleep on a pile of candy. No fairy knocks on the office door anymore.

people_low.title: The Fairies Leave
people_low.text: Tired of a useless kingdom, the fairies pack up one by one. Some go to the beastfolk forest, some to the Witch Kingdom. On the day the last fairy leaves, only Ner and Erpin remain beneath the World Tree.

people_high.title: The Fairy Democracy Declaration
people_high.text: Thanks to a queen and a Head Priestess who granted every wish, the fairies grew cockier by the day. At last they gathered in the square and shouted, "We won't listen to the queen anymore! We're making our own fairy democracy!" The first motion, 'Abolish the Head Priestess's Stamp,' passed unanimously.

faith_low.title: The Wrath of an Awakened Priest
faith_low.text: As faith in the World Tree ran dry, something awoke deep among the roots. Before the wrath of a long-sleeping priest, the Church and the Fairy Kingdom faced the World Tree's judgment.

faith_high.title: The Fairies Who Sleep Forever
faith_high.text: The fairies do nothing but pray. Under the World Tree's will, everyone has fallen asleep, and the whole kingdom has become one giant chapel.

erpin_low.title: The Queen Who Cast Off Her Crown
erpin_low.text: "Ner, I guess I'm not fit to be queen…" Erpin left her crown on the office desk and ran away from the palace.

erpin_high.title: The Uncontrollable Queen
erpin_high.text: "Hehe, Ner! From now on I'll do whatever I want!" Having been granted everything, Erpin became a tyrant of candy and cake and listened to no one. Not even Ner.

sleep.title: While Ner Slept
sleep.text: While Ner slept, the stamps Erpin pressed brought down the kingdom. When Ner wakes, there is nothing before her but ruins.

endingHints.sugar_low: When the candy stores run bare…
endingHints.sugar_high: When the kingdom drowns in sweets…
endingHints.people_low: When the fairies turn their backs on the kingdom…
endingHints.people_high: If you grant the fairies every wish…
endingHints.faith_low: When no one believes in the World Tree anymore…
endingHints.erpin_low: When Her Majesty's heart runs empty…
endingHints.erpin_high: If you indulge Her Majesty to the very end…
endingHints.true: At the end of two hundred years…
endingHints.purist: If you last 200 years without ever triggering an item or effect that stops a game over…
endingHints.reformed: If you hold back the axe for all 200 years…

trueEnding.title: Meeting You
trueEnding.text: On the night the sugar ran out and the kingdom rose up, Ner took Erpin's hand and ran beneath the roots of the World Tree. Where they followed the light, a very large stranger was waiting.

tutorial.title: Tutorial

steps.title: Signing Documents
steps.text: When a document comes in, drag a stamp onto it.
steps.try: Drag one of the stamps below onto the document.
steps.success: Stamped! Every decision moves the kingdom by what the document says, and the next one comes in.

steps.title: Four Resources
steps.text: Candy, Fairies, Faith and Erpin. If any one runs out or fills up completely, your reign ends. Not too little, not too much.

steps.title: Previewing Changes
steps.text: Lift a stamp and dots appear over the resources that will change. One dot is about 5. Whether each one rises or falls, you have to guess from the document.

steps.title: Shaky Times
steps.text: In shaky times, the same document moves things further. The number of dots stays the same, but the hotter they glow, like embers, the bigger the change.

steps.title: The Axe and Drowsiness
steps.text: You can throw away a document you dislike with the axe. But each ordinary document you chop fills one Z (drowsiness) above the axe. From the second she is too drowsy to read the dots and sees only ?, and at the third Ner falls asleep while Erpin stamps three documents in her place.
steps.try: Drag the axe down onto the document to throw it away. One Z above the axe will fill.
steps.success: The document is gone, but one Z filled up. Each one clears after the number of documents written under the axe.

steps.title: When Drowsiness Fills Up
steps.text: When all three Zs fill, Ner nods off. While she sleeps, Erpin stamps the next three documents for her, and which stamp she picks is entirely up to Erpin.
steps.try: Two Zs are already full. Use the axe once more to put Ner to sleep.
steps.success: While Ner slept, Erpin stamped three documents however she liked. When Ner wakes up, the Zs are empty again.

steps.title: Speaki's Forgeries
steps.text: Now and then Speaki slips in a forged document, pretending to be someone else. If the voice sounds a bit off, be suspicious. Chopping a forgery adds no drowsiness. In fact, the axe is the only way to catch it without a loss.
steps.try: This document is a Speaki forgery. Throw it away with the axe.
steps.success: You caught Speaki! Chopping a forgery never fills a Z.

steps.title: Items
steps.text: Some documents lead to items. Some, like the Understudy, help just by being held; others, like the Bullet or the Bandage, you drag out and use yourself.

steps.title: 200 Years
steps.text: Protect the Fairy Kingdom for 200 years. What awaits at the end… see for yourself.

tutorial.offer: First time here? Let me quickly show you how to sign documents.

menu.title: Macaron Break
menu.backNote: Go back once more to leave the game. Your progress is saved, so you can continue anytime.

purist.title: The Perfect Head Priestess
purist.text: No rewound time, no tailor's needle, no helping hand from Erpin. In two hundred years the Fairy Kingdom never once came close to falling. Ner pushed up the sunglasses said to come from outer space. "All according to plan."

reformed.title: A Changed Priestess
reformed.text: For two hundred years, the Head Priestess's axe never once struck a document in anger. Looking at her old self in the picture frame, Ner quietly thought back on the past.

cane_spread.name: Spreading Cane
cane_spread.desc: The sugar cane spreads on its own; candy rises with every document.

ember.name: Embers
ember.desc: A firework ember is still smouldering somewhere. Faith will soon take a hard hit.

strike.name: Strike
strike.desc: The fairies sent home have downed tools; candy falls with every document.

drought.name: Drought
drought.desc: The fields are dry; fairies fall with every document.

logging.name: Root Digging
logging.desc: Digging in the eastern fields hurts the World Tree's roots; Faith drops with every document.

loyalty_potion.name: Loyalty Potion
loyalty_potion.desc: Fairies rise a little with every document.

betrayal_potion.name: Betrayal Potion
betrayal_potion.desc: Fairies fall a little with every document.

ticking_parcel.name: Tick-Tock
ticking_parcel.desc: The parcel will open soon. Candy will take a hard hit.

hibernation.name: Group Nap
hibernation.desc: While the fairies nap, the Fairies gauge doesn't move.

sprout.name: Tending the Sprout
sprout.desc: The World Tree's sprout grows; faith rises with every document.

damp_storage.name: Soggy Storehouse
damp_storage.desc: The leaking roof spoils candy with every document.

axe_repair.name: Axe in Repair
axe_repair.desc: The axe is unavailable. When it returns, the drowsiness is gone.

night_escape.name: Nightly Escapes
night_escape.desc: The guards wear themselves out chasing Her Majesty's night outings. Fairies fall with every document.

sulky_queen.name: Sulky Queen
sulky_queen.desc: Her Majesty is pouting. Erpin falls with every document.

guarded_branch.name: The Branch Kept
guarded_branch.desc: The World Tree branch you refused to sell lifts faith with every document.

empty_houses.name: Empty Houses
empty_houses.desc: Neighbours follow the ones who left. Fairies fall with every document.

supply_delay.name: Supply Delays
supply_delay.desc: Monatium is slowing deliveries. Candy falls with every document.

light_greeting.name: Easy Greetings
light_greeting.desc: Relaxed greetings lift Fairies with every document.

grace_year.name: A Year of Grace
grace_year.desc: When the grace period ends, the price of candy jumps.

sugar_cut.name: Sugar Cut Off
sugar_cut.desc: Monatium has cut off the sugar. Candy drops a little with every decision.

pikora_drift.name: Pikora's Practice
pikora_drift.desc: Pikora's magic lingers, nudging a resource a little in one direction.

sylla_gale.name: Sylla's Gale
sylla_gale.desc: A hard wind blows off the spirit mountain. Faith swings harder.

yokan_cleanup.name: Yokan Cleanup
yokan_cleanup.desc: Clearing the dumped yokan costs candy with every document.

mountain_wind.name: Mountain Wind
mountain_wind.desc: The mountain wind unsettles the fairies. Population swings harder.

fence_work.name: Fence Work
fence_work.desc: Building the mountain fence costs candy with every document.

ifrit_temper.name: Ifrit's Temper
ifrit_temper.desc: Ifrit is fuming. Faith falls with every document.

fire_lesson.name: Fire Lesson
fire_lesson.desc: The queen is in a fire lesson. When it ends, Erpin takes a hard hit.

ifrit_sulk.name: Sulking Ifrit
ifrit_sulk.desc: Ifrit is sulking and the fire pillars are gone. Erpin falls with every document.

burnt_bread.name: Charred Bread
burnt_bread.desc: The festival bread is baking black. Population will soon take a hard hit.

sinking_ground.name: Sinking Ground
sinking_ground.desc: The ground under the World Tree is giving way. Faith will soon take a hard hit.

dug_garden.name: Dug-up Garden
dug_garden.desc: The palace garden is dug up and the queen is glum. Erpin falls with every document.

gabia_sulk.name: Sealed Ground
gabia_sulk.desc: Hurt, Gabia has sealed the ground. Candy will not move.

root_storage.name: Root Storehouse
root_storage.desc: Fairies keep tramping past the World Tree roots. Faith falls with every document.

naia_pout.name: Pouting Naia
naia_pout.desc: Naia is pouting and splashing the village. Population falls with every document.

queen_cold.name: Queen's Sniffles
queen_cold.desc: The queen fell in the lake and is sniffling. Erpin will soon take a hard hit.

naia_downpour.name: Endless Rain
naia_downpour.desc: Naia's rain will not stop. Candy swings harder.

drowsy_fairies.name: Nodding Off
drowsy_fairies.desc: The Sweet Dreams Potion's side effect has the fairies dozing. Candy drops with every document.

subscription_fee.name: Usage Fee
subscription_fee.desc: The display case fee keeps going out. Candy drops with every document.

dull_axe.name: Dull Axe
dull_axe.desc: The blade is too dull; the axe can't be used.

answer.title: The World Tree's Answer
answer.text: In a dream, the World Tree shows you two paths. Walk down one, and the other fades into the mist.

embrace.title: The World Tree caught us
embrace.text: Just before the fall, great roots lifted the kingdom up. The omens have grown darker since. There will be no next time.

embraceGift.title: The World Tree holds the kingdom
embraceGift.text: Year 100 of your reign. The World Tree wraps the kingdom in its arms. Once, at the moment you fall, it will catch you.

ants.name: Ants in the Storehouse
ants.desc: Candy losses run a little deeper.

rumors.name: Rumors in the Square
rumors.desc: The fairies swing a little harder.

lapsed.name: Growing Lapsed Flock
lapsed.desc: Faith losses run a little deeper.

whims.name: The Queen's Whims
whims.desc: Erpin's mood swings a little harder.

bloom.name: World Tree in Bloom
bloom.desc: The World Tree is in full flower, and more fairies come on pilgrimage. Faith rises higher.

bread.name: Bread Craze
bread.desc: Bread matters keep coming up, and the fairies cheer harder.

quiet.name: Quiet Days
quiet.desc: Lighter documents come in more often.

speaki.name: Speaki Prank Spree
speaki.desc: Forged documents slip in more often.

boom.name: Monatium Boom
boom.desc: More candy comes in, but so do Monatium documents and elf crises.

nap.name: Nap Fad
nap.desc: Faith rises a little higher, but candy income shrinks.

ghosts.name: Noisy Ghost Swamp
ghosts.desc: Guests from the Ghost Swamp visit often.

sweet.name: Sweet Storehouse
sweet.desc: Candy comes in more generously. But fairy losses run a little deeper.

napprayer.name: Nap Prayer
napprayer.desc: Faith rises higher and Church documents come more often. But candy income shrinks a little.

bestie.name: The Queen's Best Friend
bestie.desc: Erpin's mood swings less. But fairy losses run a little deeper.

careful.name: Careful Signing
careful.desc: Three uses of Insight every 25 years. But hard documents come a little more often.

thrift.name: Thrifty Storehouse
thrift.desc: Candy losses are smaller. But the fairies cheer less.

calmfaith.name: Quiet Faith
calmfaith.desc: Faith losses are smaller. But Erpin's good moods are smaller too.

fakeDocs.name: More fake documents
