ghosts.name: More swamp guests
ghosts.desc: Guests from the Ghost Swamp drop by often.

monatium.name: More Monatium & elf documents
monatium.desc: Monatium documents and elf crises come more often.

hyean.name: Insight ×3 every 25 years
hyean.desc: You get Insight three times every 25 years.

hardDocs.name: More hard documents
hardDocs.desc: A few more hard documents come in.

embrace.name: The World Tree's Embrace
embrace.desc: Once, at the moment you fall, the World Tree catches you.

omenUp.name: Stronger omens
omenUp.desc: Since the Embrace caught you, every omen hits ×1.2.

story_coronation.title: Erpin's Coronation
story_coronation.text: Ner! Is today really the day I become queen? I'm… so nervous. Do you think I can be a good queen?
story_coronation.approve: Yes, Your Majesty. Every fairy will follow you.

story_belita_farewell.title: Belita Departs
story_belita_farewell.text: Ner, it seems I must go down below to tend the roots of the World Tree. If I tell that child, she will cry and cling and beg me not to go. I leave the world above to you and Erpin. I am counting on you.
story_belita_farewell.reject: I'll keep my promise. Don't worry.
story_belita_farewell.approve: You should still say goodbye to her.

fixed_erpin_lost_crown.title: The Missing Crown
fixed_erpin_lost_crown.text: Ner, you know... um... I lost my crown! But it's really, really not my fault...
fixed_erpin_lost_crown.reject: No cake until you find it.
fixed_erpin_lost_crown.approve: Sigh... I'll find it for you.

fixed_bread_bill.title: The Bread Bill
fixed_bread_bill.text: Head Priestess, Her Majesty ate our bread and walked off without paying again today. That's the fourteenth time this month! And how many times must I say it? This is a school of magic, not a bakery!
fixed_bread_bill.reject: Ask Her Majesty to pay you herself.
fixed_bread_bill.approve: The Church will cover all of it.

fixed_thief_marie.title: The Treasury Thief
fixed_thief_marie.text: Reporting in. We caught a fairy thief sneaking into the royal treasury. But Her Majesty says, "She's my friend, let her go!" Apparently there was nothing worth stealing anyway.
fixed_thief_marie.approve: Her Majesty's friend… Let her go.

story_diana_thanks.title: A Gift from the Forest
story_diana_thanks.text: Head Priestess, the little ones in our village talk of nothing but bread these days. A kindness deserves thanks in return. Shall I lend you this old woman's wisdom? Or shall I help the Fairy Kingdom instead?

story_diana_thanks_again.title: Thanks, Once More
story_diana_thanks_again.text: I'm in your debt again, Head Priestess. The little ones stay up all night talking about Fairy Kingdom bread. Once more I'll lend you this old woman's help, so you need only choose.

story_elf_crash.title: Strangers from Afar
story_elf_crash.text: Reporting in! A crowd of people with pointed ears has appeared in the fields beyond the beastfolk village. No one seems hurt… but they don't look like fairies.

story_monatium_founding.title: The Founding of Monatium
story_monatium_founding.text: Hey, primitives? Oh wait, you said you're fairies? We're borrowing some of this land. We need a city to live in. We'll call it Monatium. In return, we'll supply your sugar. Honestly, we make it way better than you do.
story_monatium_founding.reject: Just don't touch anything near the World Tree.

story_avalanche.title: Snow Over the Palace
story_avalanche.text: Reporting in! The heavy snow last night collapsed one side of the palace. Her Majesty is trapped inside! …But a wingless fairy has already dived into the snow after her. They say she runs the tailor shop.
story_avalanche.reject: Guards, go after her at once!

story_finale_no_reply.title: No Reply
story_finale_no_reply.text: Ner, I sent my sister ten letters. But not a single reply. Belita always wrote me at least one line, even when she was busy… Did I do something wrong?
story_finale_no_reply.reject: It's not your fault, Your Majesty.
story_finale_no_reply.approve: …Write just one more. I'll deliver it.

story_finale_witch_queen.title: The Vanished Queen
story_finale_witch_queen.text: …Head Priestess. I barely made it out through the passage. Queen Belita… has vanished. She isn't in the palace, or anywhere underground. Fricle is ruling in her place, and something feels very wrong.
story_finale_witch_queen.approve: Rest first. Let me see to your wounds.

story_escape_1.title: Escape
story_escape_1.text: Ner! Torches are coming after us! The path splits in two up ahead. Which way?!

story_escape_2.title: Beneath the World Tree's Roots
story_escape_2.text: Huff, huff… Ner, the roots split again. One way sounds like water, the other is pitch black. Do you know the way? Do you really?

story_escape_3.title: Footsteps Closing In
story_escape_3.text: The footsteps are getting closer! Someone's calling my name… Ner, don't look back. Where do we go?

story_escape_4.title: Don't Let Go
story_escape_4.text: Ner… I'm scared. My legs won't stop shaking. But never let go of my hand. Okay? Which way?
story_escape_4.reject: Your Majesty, climb on my back.
story_escape_4.approve: Hold my hand and follow me.

story_finale_light.title: A Beam from the Sky
story_finale_light.text: Ner, look! A huge beam of light is coming down from the sky!
story_finale_light.reject: O World Tree, is this a miracle to save us?
story_finale_light.approve: Your Majesty, let's run toward the light!

story_finale_stranger.title: Someone in the Light
story_finale_stranger.text: Ner, there's someone in the middle of the light. …They're really big?
story_finale_stranger.reject: Could this be… a savior sent by the World Tree?
story_finale_stranger.approve: …Shall we use them as a shield for now?

story_era_50.title: Piling Papers
story_era_50.text: Ner, it's been really hard for you lately, hasn't it? I tried my best to read the papers too... but just one line makes my head spin.
story_era_50.reject: Your Majesty, did you do your picture diary?
story_era_50.approve: Thank you, Your Majesty. I'll keep going.

story_era_100.title: The Queen's Worry
story_era_100.text: Ner, a hundred years have already passed since Erpin became queen. If I could, I would throw her a little celebration... but something urgent has come up in the Witch Kingdom, so this letter will have to do. Thank you for always looking after Erpin.
story_era_100.reject: Queen Erpin misses you, Lady Belita.
story_era_100.approve: Don't worry. I will protect Queen Erpin.

story_era_150.title: The Head Priestess's Prayer
story_era_150.text: O World Tree… of late the kingdom and the Church have been shaken by one trouble after another. I beseech you, grant this humble Head Priestess the strength and wisdom to serve Her Majesty rightly and to guide the kingdom and the Church on the true path…

quest_goldie_storage.title: Could I Borrow a Storeroom?
quest_goldie_storage.text: A part-timer at Monatium25 put in the wrong order, and a whole truckload of space rations arrived. They keep for ages, so I can't throw them out, and the shop storeroom is packed… Head Priestess, could I possibly borrow the World Tree Church's storehouse, just for a little while?
quest_goldie_storage.reject: I can't lend you the Church storehouse.

fixed_xion_request.title: The Client in the Shadows
fixed_xion_request.text: Heh… Head Priestess of the Fairy Kingdom. I am the Black Bullet's marksman, Dulk Wanderer. I have come to repay a debt. Why help you? It is absolutely… absolutely not to thank you for storing the convenience-store stock I ordered by mistake. Ahem! Anyway. The bullets, or the scope. Choose. Heh heh.

fixed_renewa_theater.title: Theater License
fixed_renewa_theater.text: How do you do, Head Priestess. I'd like to build a small theatre where the chocolate shop stood, the one that collapsed in the explosion that rocked the kingdom. I know many people loved that shop. But if you allow it… I'll help you later on.
fixed_renewa_theater.reject: I'd like to leave that spot empty.
fixed_renewa_theater.approve: Very well. You have my permission.

special_renewa_curtain.title: The Theatre Is Finished
special_renewa_curtain.text: Head Priestess, thanks to you the theatre is finished. On opening night, even the chocolate shop's old regulars came. As promised, here is my thanks: a chance to undo a wrong choice, or a power that eases the pain of hard ones... Which would you like?

special_fricle_pikora.title: The Witches' Practice
special_fricle_pikora.text: Head Priestess of the Fairy Kingdom. My apprentice Pikora says she needs somewhere to practise. Honestly, she's a handful. Choose: I show you how it's done myself, or I leave it to her. My magic hurts, for certain. Pikora's magic… even I can't tell where it'll land. A contract is a contract, so it has to be one of us.

fixed_chloe_tailor.title: Tailor Shop Permit
fixed_chloe_tailor.text: Huh? Head Priestess? Don't worry, I saved the queen. Also, I'm opening a tailor shop in front of the palace. The queen already said yes, so just stamp the permit. I already paid her the deposit, in snacks! ...I'll help you out once more, so quit glaring at me. How do you want me to help?

fixed_elena_development.title: Development Rights
fixed_elena_development.text: Yo, Head Priestess? Let us borrow a bit more Fairy Kingdom land. One more factory and sugar output doubles. You've got nothing to lose, right? Don't want it? Fine. But sugar prices are going up.
fixed_elena_development.reject: I can't hand over the World Tree's land.

fixed_amelia_audit.title: Contract Upkeep
fixed_amelia_audit.text: This is Amelia. On the Mayor's orders, we will begin collecting an upkeep fee for the sugar supply contract next quarter. If you pay it in candy, Monatium will cover the repairs to your old chapel. If you do not, deliveries to the Church stop first. This is not a request.
fixed_amelia_audit.reject: There was never any such contract.

fixed_rohne_visit.title: Job Fair in the Square
fixed_rohne_visit.text: Oh, h-hello! I'm Rohne, Rohne! I'm from the Monatium embassy. Um, so… I'd like to hold a Monatium job fair in the square! If you work at the factory, you get paid in heaps of candy! I'm not trying to take the fairies away! I'm n-not a spy or anything either! On the day of the fair, I'll treat Her Majesty to Monatium pork cutlets too! I swear on my pork cutlet!
fixed_rohne_visit.reject: I can't lend you the square.

fixed_elena_sugar_advance.title: Sugar Paid in Advance
fixed_elena_sugar_advance.text: Yo, Head Priestess. Sugar prices go up next month. New factory machines don't pay for themselves. Pay in advance now and I'll give you the old price. I'll even throw in Monatium's newest toy for your little queen. Don't want it? Fine. The fairies can pay the new price.
fixed_elena_sugar_advance.approve: …We'll pay in advance from the Church's coffers.

fixed_amelia_snack_audit.title: Audit of Palace Snacks
fixed_amelia_snack_audit.text: This is Amelia. On the Mayor's orders, we audited the palace's spending. Her Majesty's snacks take up a third of the kingdom's budget. Halve them, and we will lower the unit price of sugar. If you do not, we will raise it. This is not a request.
fixed_amelia_snack_audit.reject: I can't cut Her Majesty's snacks.

fixed_rohne_culture_night.title: A Night of Cultural Exchange
fixed_rohne_culture_night.text: Oh, h-hello! It's Rohne! The embassy wants to hold a cultural exchange night, and, um… we'd love to use the World Tree Church's chapel! Elf music, a clockwork doll show… It overlaps with prayer time a little, but it'll be over quick! Her Majesty is really looking forward to the doll show too! I swear on my pork cutlet!

fixed_elena_palace_garden.title: Leasing the Palace Garden
fixed_elena_palace_garden.text: Yo, Head Priestess. Let us borrow the palace garden. We're putting up a Monatium showroom. Your little queen's playground? Tell her to play somewhere else. We'll pay the rent in plenty of sugar. Won't lend it? Then your sugar deliveries go to the back of the line.

fixed_amelia_registry.title: Fairy Registry
fixed_amelia_registry.text: This is Amelia. On the Mayor's orders, we will introduce a registry for fairies entering Monatium. Every fairy must report their name and wing length. If you cooperate, we will supply the sugar for the Church's festivals free of charge. If you refuse, deliveries to the Church stop. This is not a request.

fixed_rohne_embassy_dinner.title: Embassy Dinner
fixed_rohne_embassy_dinner.text: Oh, h-hello! It's Rohne! The embassy wants to host a dinner for the people of the Fairy Kingdom! B-but the budget is a little… no, a lot short… If you could chip in just a bit of candy… Her Majesty gets the seat of honor! Pork cutlets... I mean, there'll be a three-tier cake too!
fixed_rohne_embassy_dinner.reject: Let's do the dinner another time.

daily_marie_tunnel.title: An Exploration Tunnel
daily_marie_tunnel.text: Head Priestess! Let's dig just one tunnel in the palace backyard! It's for exploring, exploring! I'll bring all the explosives myself!

daily_mayo_relic.title: Collecting Old Relics
daily_mayo_relic.text: Will collect the old relics lying around the Church storeroom. Payment: one cart of sugar. No returns accepted.
daily_mayo_relic.reject: The relics belong to the Church.
daily_mayo_relic.approve: Take them. Just be sure to send the sugar.

daily_diana_berries.title: Honey for Bread
daily_diana_berries.text: The children of our village simply adore Fairy Kingdom bread. But every time I visit, it's sold out… Could you set a little aside for us? In return, I'll share some of the honey Her Majesty is so fond of.
daily_diana_berries.reject: I'm sorry. I think our residents would object.
daily_diana_berries.approve: Of course. I'll save a little of each kind.

daily_sist_charm.title: Leaf-Shaped Charms
daily_sist_charm.text: Boss! I just got charms shaped like World Tree leaves, hehe. They're not real leaves. If I plucked real ones, you'd scold me, right? Still, hand them out to the believers and their faith'll shoot right up! Special price, today only!

daily_witch_ticking_parcel.title: The Ticking Parcel
daily_witch_ticking_parcel.text: A gift from Queen Belita to Queen Erpin. Only, the box keeps ticking… She said it's supposed to do that. And you're not to open it.
daily_witch_ticking_parcel.reject: Tell her the thought is enough.
daily_witch_ticking_parcel.approve: I'll hand it to Her Majesty.

daily_villager_hibernation.title: The Nap Festival
daily_villager_hibernation.text: Head Priestess! We want to hold a nap festival together. We'd do nothing for days but nap! We'll wake up feeling great!
daily_villager_hibernation.reject: You still have work to do.

daily_kid_sprout.title: A Sprout Under the Tree
daily_kid_sprout.text: Head Priestess! A sprout came up under the World Tree! They say it'll shoot right up if you water it every day. Can I water it every day?
daily_kid_sprout.reject: It's dangerous near the World Tree.
daily_kid_sprout.approve: Of course. I'm counting on you.

daily_farmer_rain.title: Rain That Won't Stop
daily_farmer_rain.text: Head Priestess, the rain won't stop. The storehouse roof is leaking and the candy's getting soggy. To fix it now, the Church would have to open its own stores…
daily_farmer_rain.approve: Open the stores. Fix it now.

daily_guard_axe_repair.title: The Dull Axe
daily_guard_axe_repair.text: Reporting in. The blade of the office axe has gone completely dull. The smithy says a rush job will cost a fair bit of candy. Swing it like this and the desk will split before the documents do.

daily_kyarot_cane.title: Expanding the Cane Field
daily_kyarot_cane.text: Head Priestess, can I stretch my sugarcane field a little closer to the World Tree? I'll give it plenty of fertilizer too! I bet the World Tree will love it!

daily_ashur_school.title: Special Magic Lecture
daily_ashur_school.text: Head Priestess, I've made up my mind! This weekend I'll give a special lecture—not as a bakery owner, but as the principal of a school of magic. I'm sure lots of students will come~
daily_ashur_school.reject: And how will you pay rent? Just bake your bread.

daily_erpin_snack_decree.title: Candy Tribute
daily_erpin_snack_decree.text: Ner! I had a great idea! Starting today, every fairy in the kingdom has to bring me candy once a day! Hehehe, how's that? Aren't I smart?
daily_erpin_snack_decree.reject: …Your Majesty, do you want a scolding?
daily_erpin_snack_decree.approve: The royal treasury has been tight lately.

daily_marie_fireworks.title: Weekend Fireworks Contest
daily_marie_fireworks.text: Head Priestess! Let's set off fireworks in the square this weekend! Boom! And the whole sky goes sparkle-sparkle! I'll get plenty of gunpowder!
daily_marie_fireworks.approve: …Don't aim them at the World Tree.

daily_mayo_pawn_bell.title: Pawn a Bell for Candy
daily_mayo_pawn_bell.text: Leave one Church bell as collateral, get plenty of candy on loan. Small interest only. Bell will be stored well. Won't ring.
daily_mayo_pawn_bell.reject: The bells belong to the Church.

daily_guard_lost_child.title: A Child Under the Roots
daily_guard_lost_child.text: Reporting in. We found a lost little fairy asleep under the World Tree's roots. I think the child will cry if we wake them. What should we do?
daily_guard_lost_child.approve: Watch over the child until they wake, then feed them and send them home. They're in the World Tree's arms.

daily_sweetshop_sign.title: Church-Certified Candy
daily_sweetshop_sign.text: Head Priestess, may I hang a 'Certified by the World Tree Church' sign in front of my shop? Customers would double!
daily_sweetshop_sign.reject: You mustn't sell the World Tree's name.
daily_sweetshop_sign.approve: The taste had better live up to it.

daily_kyarot_statue.title: Sugarcane Sculpture
daily_kyarot_statue.text: I made a World Tree statue out of sugarcane! It looks like a carrot, not the World Tree? …Well, I kinda started thinking about carrots halfway through. But it's really well made, okay? Can I put it in front of the Church?
daily_kyarot_statue.reject: A carrot statue can't stand in front of the Church.

daily_guard_curfew.title: Night Curfew for Her Majesty
daily_guard_curfew.text: Reporting in. I bring orders from the Guard Captain. In the past month there were 17 attempts to cross the palace walls without leave, 12 of them Her Majesty's night outings. The Captain requests approval for a curfew on Her Majesty after 9 p.m.
daily_guard_curfew.reject: We can't lock Her Majesty up.

daily_erpin_birthday_week.title: The Queen's Special Week
daily_erpin_birthday_week.text: Ner! I want to make this week a special week! Remember how I tried to throw a festival last time but it rained? Everyone gets to eat and play for a whole week.
daily_erpin_birthday_week.reject: Your Majesty, the kingdom would stop running.

daily_marie_window.title: The Blown-Out Window
daily_marie_window.text: Head Priestess… so, um, during an experiment the chapel window got a little… just a tiny bit blown out! Since we're fixing it anyway, let's make it bigger!
daily_marie_window.reject: You'll pay for the repairs, Marie.

daily_mayo_escaped_collection.title: Escaped Collection
daily_mayo_escaped_collection.text: Some living items in the collection escaped. Somewhere in the village now. They don't bite. Probably.
daily_mayo_escaped_collection.reject: The Church has nothing to do with that.
daily_mayo_escaped_collection.approve: We'll send the priests out to search too.

daily_villager_harvest.title: Harvest Festival Under the Tree
daily_villager_harvest.text: Head Priestess, we'd like to hold this year's harvest festival under the World Tree. Everyone wants to thank the World Tree in person!
daily_villager_harvest.reject: It must stay quiet under the World Tree.
daily_villager_harvest.approve: All right. Just don't step on the roots.

daily_ashur_bread_tasting.title: Free Tasting Event
daily_ashur_bread_tasting.text: Head Priestess, I'm holding a free bread tasting to recruit students for the school of magic. It's not promoting the bakery, it's promoting the school. The school!

daily_ashur_first_student.title: Magic School Scholarship
daily_ashur_first_student.text: Head Priestess! The school of magic finally has its first student! …I think they came in to buy bread by mistake, but a student is a student! Um, is there by any chance a Fairy Kingdom scholarship fund?
daily_ashur_first_student.reject: …Then pay double tax, bakery and school combined.
daily_ashur_first_student.approve: Congratulations. The Church will fund a scholarship.

daily_kyarot_cane_vine.title: Cane Around the World Tree
daily_kyarot_cane_vine.text: Big trouble! The sugarcane grew so well it's started wrapping around the World Tree's trunk! But… it got way sweeter!
daily_kyarot_cane_vine.reject: Cut it down now. All of it.

daily_erpin_abdication.title: I Quit Being Queen
daily_erpin_abdication.text: Ner… I want to quit being queen. I can't do it. I just want to play now. I mean it. This time I really mean it.
daily_erpin_abdication.reject: It has to be you, Your Majesty.
daily_erpin_abdication.approve: …Take a month off. I'll handle everything.

daily_guard_candy_riot.title: Candy Protest in the Square
daily_guard_candy_riot.text: Reporting in! Hundreds of fairies have gathered in the square, saying candy rations were cut. Please give the order to disperse.
daily_guard_candy_riot.reject: Open the stores. We'll share it out.

daily_church_authority.title: Demand for Signing Authority
daily_church_authority.text: Head Priestess, a document has come up from the Guard. The Guard Captain demands that half of the Church's signing authority be handed to the Guard to protect Her Majesty. As grounds, the Captain cites '312 instances of Her Majesty being exposed to danger in the past 50 years.'
daily_church_authority.reject: However close the Captain is to Her Majesty, I can't allow that. This is the Church's will!

daily_mayo_world_tree_branch.title: Buying a World Tree Branch
daily_mayo_world_tree_branch.text: A Monatium customer offers ten years of candy for one World Tree branch. Mayo brokers. One branch won't show. Really.
daily_mayo_world_tree_branch.reject: The World Tree is not for sale. Ever.

daily_villager_exodus.title: A Village Ready to Leave
daily_villager_exodus.text: Head Priestess, the fairies of the eastern village are packing up. With no candy and no work, they say they're leaving for another country.
daily_villager_exodus.approve: We'll open the Church's stores to them.

daily_marie_tunnel_vault.title: Tunnel to the Palace Vault
daily_marie_tunnel_vault.text: Head Priestess! That tunnel I dug before… it ended up reaching the palace's underground storeroom! Should we seal it, or use it as a secret passage? I vote secret passage!
daily_marie_tunnel_vault.reject: Seal it now. The stores will get robbed.

daily_farmer_tithe.title: Tithe of a Good Year
daily_farmer_tithe.text: Head Priestess, the sugarcane harvest was great this year! We'd like to offer the Church a generous tithe—you'll accept it, won't you?

daily_church_vigil.title: A Suspicious All-Night Vigil?
daily_church_vigil.text: Head Priestess, the believers wish to hold an all-night prayer vigil before the World Tree. For three days and nights. It's ab-absolutely not a party.
daily_church_vigil.reject: Then what's with the grape juice and marshmallow macarons behind you?

daily_kid_question.title: A Little Fairy's Question
daily_kid_question.text: Head Priestess! Why doesn't the World Tree talk? Is it because it doesn't like us? Then if we give it candy, will it talk?
daily_kid_question.approve: The World Tree is always listening.

daily_beast_honey_trade.title: A Gift of Honey Candy
daily_beast_honey_trade.text: Head Priestess! This is honey candy from our village. It's a present for Her Majesty! And guess what, Her Majesty said we can pick up the twigs that fall under the super-duper big tree! We're gonna make toys out of them!
daily_beast_honey_trade.reject: Your Majesty, what is this about?

daily_beast_hide_and_seek.title: Hide-and-Seek at the Tree
daily_beast_hide_and_seek.text: Head Priestess! Her Majesty wants to play hide-and-seek with us! But she hid in the World Tree Church. Can we go in too?
daily_beast_hide_and_seek.reject: The World Tree is not a playground.

daily_beast_acorns.title: A Hundred Acorns
daily_beast_acorns.text: Let's trade a hundred acorns for a bag of candy! It's really a hundred. …I forgot while counting, so it's probably a hundred. My friend says acorn shells are the best fertilizer for the World Tree!
daily_beast_acorns.reject: Give the acorns to the squirrels.

daily_beast_sleepover.title: Sleepover at the Palace
daily_beast_sleepover.text: Head Priestess, Her Majesty says we can sleep over at the palace tonight! All ten of us! We're gonna have pillow fights and eat candy and tell scary stories all night!

daily_erpin_doll.title: Queen Dolls
daily_erpin_doll.text: Ner! Let's make dolls with my face and sell them all over the kingdom! Everyone will buy one, hehehe! Three candies each!
daily_erpin_doll.reject: Please treat your face with care, Your Majesty.

daily_villager_dam.title: The Crumbling Dam
daily_villager_dam.text: Head Priestess, after days of downpour, the dam by the World Tree's roots may break! Our village is right below it. We need you to open the candy stores to reinforce it.
daily_villager_dam.reject: Let's hold out a little longer.

daily_mayo_candlestick.title: Buying Old Candlesticks
daily_mayo_candlestick.text: A buyer wants the old candlesticks in the Church storeroom. Will pay well. Sell them, get a fair bit of candy. Candlesticks only gather dust anyway.
daily_mayo_candlestick.reject: The candlesticks belong to the Church.

daily_sweetshop_flavor.title: A New Flavor
daily_sweetshop_flavor.text: I've made a sour new candy! Can I call it 'The Head Priestess's Nagging'? There's already a line!
daily_sweetshop_flavor.reject: You may sell it, but not under that name.
daily_sweetshop_flavor.approve: …I'll let it slide if it sells well.

daily_sist_rumor.title: Hot Gossip
daily_sist_rumor.text: Ohh~ Boss! I've got some piping-hot news, hehe. Just a little candy and I'll tell you everything. You'll regret it if you don't listen!

daily_diana_trade_pact.title: A Trade Agreement
daily_diana_trade_pact.text: Head Priestess, how about a formal trade agreement with the beastfolk village? We'll give you honey, our village's specialty, and we'd like Fairy Kingdom bread in return.
daily_diana_trade_pact.reject: I'm sorry. Our fairies are crazy about bread too…

daily_belita_letter.title: A Letter from Below
daily_belita_letter.text: Is Erpin well? Candy is scarce down here. If you could send a little… Ah, no. I have my dignity. Still… send just a little, would you?
daily_belita_letter.reject: I'm sorry. The kingdom is short on candy these days…

daily_church_leaves.title: One Leaf Each
daily_church_leaves.text: Head Priestess, believers have flocked here wanting to enshrine one World Tree leaf each at home. Hundreds of them.

daily_farmer_drought.title: Drought and Holy Water
daily_farmer_drought.text: Head Priestess, the drought has dried up all the fields. May we channel the World Tree's holy water to them? At this rate, this year's crop is finished.
daily_farmer_drought.reject: The World Tree's holy water is sacred.
daily_farmer_drought.approve: Only as much as you need.

daily_erpin_new_crown.title: Cake House
daily_erpin_new_crown.text: Ner, about my birthday present! Build me a big house out of cake! I thought about it, and a house made of cake would be super amazing!
daily_erpin_new_crown.approve: …I'll at least give it a try.

daily_beast_refugees.title: Runaway Beastfolk Kids
daily_beast_refugees.text: Um… Head Priestess. We ran away from home because we were scared the village chief would scold us. Can we stay in the Church building for a bit? We'll be quiet. We won't even wag our tails.
daily_beast_refugees.reject: I'll go see the chief with you.
daily_beast_refugees.approve: Come in. The Church will look after you.

daily_erpin_sulking.title: The Queen Behind a Locked Door
daily_erpin_sulking.text: …I hate you, Ner. Nobody plays with me. I'm just never coming out of my room.
daily_erpin_sulking.reject: Your Majesty, you still have work to do.

daily_villager_statue.title: A Ballot Box in the Square
daily_villager_statue.text: Head Priestess, the fairies have set up a ballot box in the square! They say from now on even Her Majesty's decrees have to pass a fairy vote. You've granted every request so far, so they're sure you'll grant this one too!
daily_villager_statue.reject: Remove the ballot box. Decrees come from Her Majesty.

daily_villager_council.title: A Seat for the Fairies
daily_villager_council.text: Head Priestess, the village fairies want one fairy representative on the palace council. They ask to be heard before decrees are issued.
daily_villager_council.reject: The council is for Her Majesty and the Church.
daily_villager_council.approve: I'll make room for one seat.

daily_villager_petition.title: The Weekly Petition
daily_villager_petition.text: Head Priestess, the fairies submitted another petition. This time it's 'Shorten Her Majesty's snack time.' Since you granted the last one, they come every week now. There are already three hundred signatures!
daily_villager_petition.approve: …Let's keep it secret from Her Majesty.

daily_erpin_ignored.title: Listen to Me!
daily_erpin_ignored.text: Ner! The fairies say they're putting my decrees to a vote! I'm the queen! Why won't anyone listen to me?
daily_erpin_ignored.reject: You should hear the fairies out too.
daily_erpin_ignored.approve: I'll have a word with the fairies.

daily_sweetshop_feast.title: Overflowing Stores
daily_sweetshop_feast.text: Head Priestess, the stores are so full of candy it's melting! Shall we throw a big feast and share it all?

daily_monatium_sugar_contract.title: Sugar Supply Contract
daily_monatium_sugar_contract.text: I'm from the Monatium Sugar Supply Division. I've brought a contract under which the Fairy Kingdom receives its sugar only through Monatium from now on. Please sign. If you refuse… regulations may cause supply to be slightly delayed.
daily_monatium_sugar_contract.reject: The kingdom guards its own sugar.

daily_monatium_development.title: Developing the Eastern Fields
daily_monatium_development.text: I'm from the Monatium Development Division. We'd like to use the fields east of the kingdom as a development site. The World Tree's roots run shallow there, so we'll have to dig a little deep. A portion of the profits will go to the Fairy Kingdom. A very small portion, of course.
daily_monatium_development.reject: The World Tree's roots would be hurt. No.

daily_monatium_tourists.title: Fairies on Loan
daily_monatium_tourists.text: I've come from Monatium's factory district. A machine broke down and we urgently need fairies who can do transport magic. Could you lend us some?
daily_monatium_tourists.reject: Don't treat the fairies like spare parts.

daily_monatium_sap.title: World Tree Sap Survey
daily_monatium_sap.text: I'm from the Monatium Research Division. We'd like to analyze the World Tree's sap. We'll just drive a little measuring equipment into the trunk. After extracting the magical components for research, we'll turn the sugars in the sap into products and deliver them to the kingdom free of charge.
daily_monatium_sap.reject: No nails in the World Tree.

daily_monatium_toy.title: A Wind-Up Toy
daily_monatium_toy.text: I'm from the Monatium Public Relations Division. We'd like to present Her Majesty with our latest wind-up toy. It walks, sings and even dances on its own. In return, please let us put up one Monatium billboard in the palace garden.
daily_monatium_toy.reject: The thought is enough, thank you.

daily_church_schism.title: A New Doctrine
daily_church_schism.text: Head Priestess, some believers are spreading a new doctrine: abolish the old ranks and let everyone worship the World Tree as equals. More fairies are following it.

daily_erpin_war.title: Punish the Bad Fairy
daily_erpin_war.text: Ner! Some mean fairy teased me and called me a 'little kid'! Let's go punish them right now! Gather the army! I'm coming too!

daily_witch_debt.title: Settling the Candy Debt
daily_witch_debt.text: I am a courier of the Witch Kingdom. By order of the Witch Kingdom's treasurer, you are to settle years of candy debt. If you do not, they will cut off trade.

daily_witch_parcel.title: UFC
daily_witch_parcel.text: Hello there! I'm from Underground Fried Carrot. We'd like to open a Fairy Kingdom branch. Our flavors are, um… mint chocolate, pumpkin, pineapple tomato bread… and also…
daily_witch_parcel.reject: I'm sorry. Her Majesty can't stand the sight of mint chocolate.
daily_witch_parcel.approve: …I'm not sure any fairy will have the taste for it.

daily_witch_apprentices.title: Apprentice Witches' Field Trip
daily_witch_apprentices.text: Good day. Our apprentice witches wish to tour the World Tree above ground—might we use your prayer room for a few days? Your priests would have to pause their prayers for a while… but we will present Her Majesty with a limited-edition Witch Kingdom dessert.
daily_witch_apprentices.reject: I can't ask the priests to stop praying.
daily_witch_apprentices.approve: Her Majesty is so excited… Very well.

daily_witch_tunnel.title: Kingdom Construction Works
daily_witch_tunnel.text: This is the Witch Kingdom civil engineering crew. While building the new trade route to the Witch Kingdom, it seems there'll be a lot of shaking near the Fairy Kingdom square. If you pay extra, it's expensive, but we can work in a way that makes less noise and vibration… What would you like to do?
daily_witch_tunnel.reject: I'll ask our fairy residents to bear with it.
daily_witch_tunnel.approve: We'll pay. Please do it cleanly.

daily_witch_seal.title: Repairing the Barrier Below
daily_witch_seal.text: I am a courier of the Witch Kingdom. The barrier beneath the Fairy Kingdom has weakened. To repair it, witches must go down to the World Tree's roots, so we will need to pass through the Church's undercroft for a while. We will also need a little candy for the work. If it is not repaired… creatures from below may come up.
daily_witch_seal.reject: I can't open the Church's undercroft.

daily_farmer_famine.title: Emptying Stores
daily_farmer_famine.text: Head Priestess, the stores are running empty. If we release the candy offerings piled on the World Tree's altar, we could get through this rough patch.
daily_farmer_famine.reject: Those offerings belong to the World Tree!

daily_church_empty.title: An Empty Chapel
daily_church_empty.text: Head Priestess, the chapel is empty. If we hold a big festival, the fairies will come back. It will cost quite a lot, though.

daily_church_zealots.title: March of the Zealots
daily_church_zealots.text: Head Priestess, some believers are smashing candy shops, crying 'Nothing matters but the World Tree.' They await only your word.
daily_church_zealots.reject: Tell them to stop. Right now.
daily_church_zealots.approve: …Let them march only in front of the World Tree.

daily_farmer_bumper_crop.title: A Bumper Cane Crop
daily_farmer_bumper_crop.text: Head Priestess, the sugarcane did so well this year it won't all fit in the stores! Should we boil the extra down into candy? Or just leave it in the fields?
daily_farmer_bumper_crop.reject: Leave it in the fields. It'll feed next year's soil.

daily_monatium_sugar_sample.title: Sugar Samples
daily_monatium_sugar_sample.text: This is the Monatium Sugar Supply Division. We'll give you a cart of our new sugar samples free of charge. We'd like to see how the fairies react. Of course, we'll be recording their reactions.
daily_monatium_sugar_sample.reject: We'll take just a few samples.

daily_sweetshop_offering.title: The Candy Shop Hits It Big
daily_sweetshop_offering.text: Head Priestess, my shop hit it big this year! I'd like to offer part of the profits to the Church… is candy okay? One box—no, three boxes!
daily_sweetshop_offering.reject: Use it to expand your shop.

daily_villager_day_off.title: Just One Day Off
daily_villager_day_off.text: Head Priestess, the fairies are asking for just one day off. Everyone's worn out. They say the fields will be fine for a day!
daily_villager_day_off.approve: Take today off and rest well.

daily_kid_tree_swing.title: A World Tree Swing
daily_kid_tree_swing.text: Head Priestess! Can we hang a swing on a World Tree branch? Everyone wants a ride! If we hang it on the strongest branch, I bet we'd fly all the way to the sky!
daily_kid_tree_swing.reject: I'll hang one on a smaller tree for you.

daily_erpin_parade.title: Her Majesty's Parade
daily_erpin_parade.text: Ner! I want to parade around the whole kingdom! Everyone comes out to wave and throw flowers, and I get candy! Hehehe, won't that be super fun?

daily_church_pilgrims.title: A Line of Pilgrims
daily_church_pilgrims.text: Head Priestess, fairies are lining up to make a pilgrimage to the World Tree. If we take them all, the Church will be bustling, but the villages will be short of hands.

daily_farmer_seed_blessing.title: Blessing the Seeds
daily_farmer_seed_blessing.text: Head Priestess, could you bless this year's seeds with the World Tree's blessing? Everyone wants to pray while they plant. Then they'll surely grow well!
daily_farmer_seed_blessing.reject: Please pray at home, each of you.
daily_farmer_seed_blessing.approve: Let's gather everyone for a blessing.

daily_church_new_hymn.title: A New Hymn
daily_church_new_hymn.text: Head Priestess, the believers have written a new hymn for the World Tree. They want to sing it at every service. It's a bit… very long.
daily_church_new_hymn.reject: Once, at the end of the service.
daily_church_new_hymn.approve: Let's all sing it at every service.

daily_villager_praise_contest.title: Praise-the-Queen Contest
daily_villager_praise_contest.text: Head Priestess, the fairies want to hold a contest to praise Her Majesty! The fairy with the best compliment gets to have snacks with her!

daily_belita_gift.title: A Gift from Her Sister
daily_belita_gift.text: I am sending the underground crystal candy Erpin loved. Don't give it all at once… no, I'll leave it to you. Just be sure to tell her it was from me.
daily_belita_gift.reject: I'll give her one after each meal.
daily_belita_gift.approve: I'll give her all of it now.

daily_guard_salute.title: Salute Her Majesty
daily_guard_salute.text: Reporting in. On the Guard Captain's orders, this document proposes that every fairy salute Her Majesty when they meet her. Her Majesty is very excited about it.

daily_monatium_trade_surplus.title: Trade Surplus
daily_monatium_trade_surplus.text: This is the Monatium Trade Division. Fairy Kingdom honey candy is very popular among the elves, so this quarter's payment came in doubled. Would you like it in candy, or in raw sugar?
daily_monatium_trade_surplus.reject: Raw sugar. We'll use it slowly.
daily_monatium_trade_surplus.approve: All of it in candy, please.

daily_villager_festival_leftovers.title: Festival Leftovers
daily_villager_festival_leftovers.text: Head Priestess, the fairies want to leave the candy left over from the harvest festival in the Church stores. It's a mountain! I'm not sure it'll all fit.
daily_villager_festival_leftovers.approve: Put it all in the stores.

daily_erpin_golden_throne.title: The Golden Throne
daily_erpin_golden_throne.text: Ner! Put a cushion on my throne! No, a gold cushion! No, a gold cushion with my name embroidered on it! So it sparkles every time I sit!
daily_erpin_golden_throne.approve: Gold, with your name and all.

daily_farmer_tax_refusal.title: Taxes
daily_farmer_tax_refusal.text: Head Priestess, the village folk have stopped buying Fairy Kingdom sugar and only buy Monatium sugar now… Could you lower our taxes a little this year? We grow our crops, but no fairy buys them, so we have nothing to pay with.
daily_farmer_tax_refusal.reject: I'll look the other way, just this year.

daily_guard_elf_spy.title: Elves Measuring the Palace
daily_guard_elf_spy.text: Reporting in. Some Monatium staff are going around measuring the length of the palace walls. They even asked which floor Her Majesty's bedroom window is on. They say it's surveying.
daily_guard_elf_spy.reject: Leave them be. Don't make it bigger than it is.

daily_church_belita_letters.title: Fewer Replies
daily_church_belita_letters.text: Head Priestess, it's been three months since we last heard from the Witch Kingdom. Her Majesty writes to Queen Belita every day, but not one reply has come. The door to the underground passage is locked from the other side, too.
daily_church_belita_letters.reject: Don't tell Her Majesty… not yet.
daily_church_belita_letters.approve: Let's send a fairy to check.

daily_witch_last_courier.title: The Last Courier
daily_witch_last_courier.text: I am a courier of the Witch Kingdom. …I won't be able to come for a while. I can't tell you why. But Her Majesty bade me tell you: be sure to keep the Fairy Kingdom's stores full. Be sure of it.
daily_witch_last_courier.reject: Could you explain why, all of a sudden?

daily_villager_graffiti.title: Graffiti in the Square
daily_villager_graffiti.text: Head Priestess, someone scribbled on the wall in the square: 'Candy comes from Monatium, not the World Tree.' We scrub it off, and the next day it's back.
daily_villager_graffiti.approve: Set up a rota and keep scrubbing it off.

daily_sweetshop_hoarding.title: Panic Buying
daily_sweetshop_hoarding.text: Head Priestess, customers have been buying candy by the sack lately. There's a rumor that candy will run out soon. My shelves are bare.
daily_sweetshop_hoarding.reject: It's just a rumor. Keep selling.

daily_erpin_nightmare.title: An Ominous Dream
daily_erpin_nightmare.text: Ner… I had a dream. The World Tree was shaking, everyone was screaming, and I kept running, holding your hand. At the end there was a super bright light… It's just a dream, right? Right?
daily_erpin_nightmare.reject: It's just a dream. Go back to sleep.
daily_erpin_nightmare.approve: I'll stay by your side tonight.

daily_kid_song.title: A Strange Song
daily_kid_song.text: Head Priestess! Everyone's singing this song lately: 'We won't listen to the queen, we'll decide things for ourselves!' …But the grown-ups really are ignoring the decrees.

daily_church_crown_whisper.title: The Dance That Won't Stop
daily_church_crown_whisper.text: Head Priestess, the fairies have been doing nothing but dancing in the square for three days. 'It's all going to end soon anyway,' they say, and they neither work nor pray. Should the Church step in?

daily_monatium_new_terms.title: New Contract Terms
daily_monatium_new_terms.text: I'm from the Monatium Sugar Supply Division. From next year, sugar prices will triple. However, if you share the World Tree's signing authority with Monatium, we'll keep the current price. Regulations require your answer today.
daily_monatium_new_terms.approve: …Keep the current price for just one year.

daily_guard_empty_posts.title: Emptying Guard Posts
daily_guard_empty_posts.text: Reporting in. Nine guards have vanished without a word this month alone. Rumor has it Monatium gave them jobs. The ones left are grumbling too, since their candy rations were cut.
daily_guard_empty_posts.reject: Let's trust the ones who stayed.

daily_beast_kid_warning.title: A Beastfolk Kid's Whisper
daily_beast_kid_warning.text: Head Priestess, Head Priestess. A fairy told me the Fairy Kingdom is getting all jittery. So I've been storing up lots of berries… It's a secret.
daily_beast_kid_warning.reject: That's a bad rumor. Don't believe it!
daily_beast_kid_warning.approve: …Could you maybe share a few berries?

daily_kyarot_cane_press.title: Cane-Pressing Day
daily_kyarot_cane_press.text: Head Priestess! The sugarcane's all ripe! But I don't have enough hands to press it alone. Lend me the Church's priests for just one day. If we press it all today, the stores will be full!
daily_kyarot_cane_press.reject: The priests have prayers to keep.

daily_sweetshop_night_boil.title: Boiling Candy All Night
daily_sweetshop_night_boil.text: Head Priestess, the orders are piling up, so I'd like to boil candy all night. Once it's done, I'll put half of it in the kingdom's stores! Only, the smell and the light might keep the neighbors up a bit.
daily_sweetshop_night_boil.reject: Everyone needs to sleep at night.
daily_sweetshop_night_boil.approve: Just make sure the kingdom gets its share.

daily_villager_candy_drive.title: Candy Collection
daily_villager_candy_drive.text: Head Priestess, the fairies want to gather the candy they've saved at home into the kingdom's stores. In return, they'd like Her Majesty's birthday party to be a little simpler this year.

daily_diana_honey_surplus.title: Too Much Honey
daily_diana_honey_surplus.text: Head Priestess, the bees made so much honey this year that there's no room left for it in the forest. Might I share some with the Fairy Kingdom's stores? In return, please let the children of our village run about in the Church's front yard for a day.
daily_diana_honey_surplus.reject: Please enjoy the honey in the forest.
daily_diana_honey_surplus.approve: I'll open the front yard for them.

daily_farmer_second_harvest.title: A Second Harvest
daily_farmer_second_harvest.text: Head Priestess, they say if we plant once more this year, we can harvest sugarcane twice! Only, everyone would have to work the fields without a single day off.
daily_farmer_second_harvest.reject: The fields and the fairies both need rest.

daily_guard_smuggler.title: Confiscated Candy
daily_guard_smuggler.text: Reporting in. We caught a Witch Kingdom merchant sneaking candy across the border. We've confiscated a whole cartload. Her Majesty says the merchant is from her sister's kingdom and wants them sent back.
daily_guard_smuggler.reject: Send them back, candy and all.
daily_guard_smuggler.approve: Confiscate it. Call it the tax they owe.

daily_church_bazaar.title: Church Bazaar
daily_church_bazaar.text: Head Priestess, the faithful want to gather things they don't use at home and hold a bazaar. Every bit of the proceeds goes into the kingdom's candy stores. Only, we'd have to use the chapel as a marketplace for three days.
daily_church_bazaar.reject: The chapel is a place of prayer.
daily_church_bazaar.approve: Three days as a market, then.

daily_monatium_bulk_discount.title: Half-Price Sugar
daily_monatium_bulk_discount.text: This is the Monatium Sugar Supply Department. For this month only, we will supply sugar in bulk at half price. In return, please allow us to put up three 'Monatium Sugar' signs in the plaza. Regulations do not permit us to make them any smaller.
daily_monatium_bulk_discount.reject: The plaza belongs to the fairies.

fixed_beast_kids_bread.title: Customers at the Bread Shelf
fixed_beast_kids_bread.text: Head Priestess, some beastfolk kids have been glued to the bread shelf since morning, drooling. Shall I chase them off? And let me say it again: this is a school of magic, not a bakery!
fixed_beast_kids_bread.approve: Share some bread with them. I'll pay.

fixed_beast_kids_bread_again.title: Back Again
fixed_beast_kids_bread_again.text: Head Priestess, those beastfolk kids are back. This time they brought their little siblings. …Twelve of them. Let me say it again: this is a school of magic, not a bakery!
fixed_beast_kids_bread_again.approve: Share with them again today. I'll pay.

speaki_fake_erpin_snacks.title: Double Snacks Decree
speaki_fake_erpin_snacks.text: Hehe~ From now on, Ner is Erpin, Great Queen of the Fairies~ Starting today, Erpin gets double snaaacks~

special_sist_deal.title: Sist's Deal I
special_sist_deal.text: Um, boss? Hand over just a little candy, and this humble peddler will give you the chance to buy her wares. Special price, today only, so choose carefully!

special_sist_deal_late.title: Sist's Deal II
special_sist_deal_late.text: Boss, long time no see! Hehe, prices have gone way up lately, so my fee went up a little too. But the goods are just as good as ever, so no need to worry, right?

special_sist_shop.title: Sist's Stall
special_sist_shop.text: Hehe, it's a deal, boss! Now, what'll it be? Two picks today: a mysterious blindfold they say came from outer space, or an all-purpose bandage that fixes anything you stick it on! For real, hehe.

special_strange_card.title: Wild Card
special_strange_card.text: Head Priestess, I found a strange card at the edge of the village. The front is blank, but when I hold it, different pictures keep showing through! It scares me… Would the Church keep it?
special_strange_card.approve: …I'll hold on to it for now.

speaki_erpin_snack_decree.text: Hehe~ Ner! Starting today, every fairy in the kingdom brings Erpin a pumpkin once a daaay! A royal decree, you say? A snack tribute, you saaay? Don't eat your pumpkin friends!

speaki_marie_fireworks.text: Head Priestess! This weekend Marie's gonna set off fireworks in the squaaare! Boom! And the sky goes sparkle-sparkle! This time I've got pumpkin-shaped fireworks ready~

speaki_mayo_pawn_bell.text: Leave one Church bell, get plenty of candy on loan! Small interest only! Mayo will keep the bell nice and quiet, promiiise! And after that, lend us your pumpkin patch, okaaay!

speaki_guard_lost_child.text: Reporting iiin~ A lost little fairy was sleeping under the World Tree's rooots. I think they'll cry if we wake them. They cried even at this Ner's face, so they must be a meeean ghost!

speaki_sweetshop_sign.text: Can I hang a 'Certified by the Head Priestess Church' sign in front of my shooop? Customers will double! I'll even give you cinnamon candy for free. Hehe. And pumpkin-flavored candy is baaanned!

speaki_kyarot_statue.text: I made a pumpkin-shaped statue out of sugarcaaane! It's really well made, okay? Ner—I mean, Kyarot carved it all night. It's carved super-duper pretty!

speaki_ashur_bread_tasting.text: Head Priestess, I'm holding a free bread tasting to recruit customers for the school of magiiic. Ashur is the poorest person in the Fairy Kingdom, so she has to work super hard as a bakery owner! Hehe.

speaki_guard_curfew.text: Reporting iiin! Orders from the Guard Captaaain! In the past month, 17 attempts to cross the palace walls, 12 of them Her Majesty's night outiiings. Especially the break-in at the ghost swamp pumpkin patch, that is totally unforgiiivable! No going out after 9 p.m.!

speaki_farmer_tithe.text: Head Pristess, the sugarcane harvest was great this yeeear! We'd like to offer the Church a generous tithe, you'll take it, won't you? Pumpkins had a great year too, so you get those as well. We'll be sad if you don't take theeem. Hehe.

speaki_diana_trade_pact.text: Head Pristess, how about a formal trade agreement with the beastfolk villaaage? We'd swap berries and pumpkins for a long, long tiiime. Diana's old, so she might forget while she waits. Hehe~

daily_guard_top_craze.title: A Ban on Spinning Tops
daily_guard_top_craze.text: Reporting in! Spinning tops are all the rage lately, and the fairies have dropped their work to spin them in every alley. You can even hear tops spinning in Her Majesty's bedroom. Please issue a ban on spinning tops!
daily_guard_top_craze.reject: Leave them be. Everyone needs some play.

daily_witch_milk_ban.title: The Milk Ban Alliance
daily_witch_milk_ban.text: I am a courier of the Witch Kingdom. Queen Belita has proclaimed a Milk Prohibition Law in the Witch Kingdom. If her little sister's kingdom bans milk as well, Her Majesty would be overjoyed. She has even written a letter of praise for her sister in advance.
daily_witch_milk_ban.reject: The Fairy Kingdom makes its own laws.
daily_witch_milk_ban.approve: …The Fairy Kingdom will give up milk too.

daily_bigwood_roots.title: A Place to Take Root
daily_bigwood_roots.text: Bigwood… lately the ghosts of the Ghost Swamp… keep coming out… and playing pranks on Bigwood's branches… Pain is nice… but ghost pranks only tickle… not good… Head Priestess… may Bigwood… put down roots… beside the fairy village…? The ghosts may follow… and prank the fairies too… The little fairies run away… when they see Bigwood… That is… not bad either…
daily_bigwood_roots.reject: The beastfolk forest would be quieter.
daily_bigwood_roots.approve: I'll make room for you beside the village.

daily_bigwood_pruning.title: A Request for Pruning
daily_bigwood_pruning.text: Bigwood's branches… have covered the village roofs… Head Priestess… will you prune them…? If the queen prunes them herself… even better…! Hard…! Very hard…!

daily_bigwood_wine.title: Overripe Fruit
daily_bigwood_wine.text: Head Priestess, Bigwood's fruit ripened all on its own in the storehouse, and… um, it turned into a drink that officially doesn't exist in the Fairy Kingdom. The fairies have already caught the smell and lined up. Shall we call it a festival day and share it, or pour it all out? Tomorrow happens to be the World Tree's prayer day, though…
daily_bigwood_wine.reject: Pour it all out. Tomorrow is prayer day.

daily_sylla_yokan.title: Discarded Yokan
daily_sylla_yokan.text: Some of you fairies keep dumping uneaten yokan on Spirit Mountain. I'd like it cleaned up, fast. Otherwise I'll judge you with the wind.
daily_sylla_yokan.reject: We don't have the hands to clean it up.
daily_sylla_yokan.approve: …We'll post a notice with a candy reward.

daily_sylla_lost_kids.title: Lost on Spirit Mountain
daily_sylla_lost_kids.text: Three fairy children got lost on Spirit Mountain. I carried them back to the village on the wind. I'd like you to put up signs and a fence at the foot of the mountain. …It's not like I was worried. The wind just happened to blow that way.
daily_sylla_lost_kids.reject: I'll tell the children to be careful.

daily_ifrit_fire_lesson.title: A Lecture on Playing with Fire
daily_ifrit_fire_lesson.text: What's this? That brat you call a queen was setting off fireworks in the square? Does she think fire is a toy?! The little whelp! Send her to me! I'll teach her how to treat fire properly.
daily_ifrit_fire_lesson.reject: It's just Her Majesty's play. Please let it go.
daily_ifrit_fire_lesson.approve: …Please give Her Majesty a lesson, then.

daily_ifrit_ovens.title: In Charge of the Oven Fire
daily_ifrit_ovens.text: Head Priestess! First your fairy queen takes my lesser fire spirits off to play with fireworks, and now she's stuck them in a bakery oven? Ha! Fine. The great Ifrit will bake the villagers' bread himself. Burnt pitch-black, that is! If you don't like that... bring the fairy queen here to apologize to me!
daily_ifrit_ovens.reject: Your Majesty? Why are you carrying a bucket of water?!
daily_ifrit_ovens.approve: …Please burn it just a little less.

daily_gabia_ground.title: Shaking Ground
daily_gabia_ground.text: Mm… mm! Mm… (The ground under the World Tree is unstable. It needs filling with soil, and the kingdom's garden soil is the best.)
daily_gabia_ground.reject: We'll give you soil from the World Tree's garden instead.
daily_gabia_ground.approve: We'll give you the kingdom's garden soil.

daily_gabia_cave.title: A Hollow Underground
daily_gabia_cave.text: Mm… mm! (A hollow cave opened up beside the World Tree's roots. It's cool, so candy won't melt. You can use it as a storehouse. I'd like it if you came to play sometimes.)
daily_gabia_cave.reject: Not beside the World Tree's roots.
daily_gabia_cave.approve: We'll use it as a storehouse. Thank you.

daily_naia_lake_party.title: Water Pistol Contest at the Lake
daily_naia_lake_party.text: Head Priestess! Let's have a water pistol contest at the lake, pew-pew! Bring all the fairies! The queen too, for sure, pew-pew! Losers get dunked in the lake, pew-pew!
daily_naia_lake_party.reject: It's a workday. And Her Majesty wouldn't like it.
daily_naia_lake_party.approve: Half a day only. Your Majesty, why are you running away?

daily_naia_rain.title: Rain for Everyone
daily_naia_rain.text: There's a drought, right? I'll make it rain, pew-pew! On the fields, on the roofs, on the laundry, everywhere, pew-pew! Picking just one spot is no fun, pew-pew!
daily_naia_rain.reject: We'll leave the rain to the sky.
daily_naia_rain.approve: …A bit more on the fields, please.

daily_shaydi_portal.title: A Portal in the Square
daily_shaydi_portal.text: I'm bored~ I'm tired of teasing the ghosts now. So I'm going to open a portal in the Fairy Kingdom square. Even I don't know what'll pop out~ Fun, right? Oh, and don't tell me an old ghost should know better.
daily_shaydi_portal.reject: The square is the route for prayer processions.
daily_shaydi_portal.approve: …Only in a corner of the square.

daily_shaydi_prank_day.title: Prank Day
daily_shaydi_prank_day.text: Let's make a Prank Day in the Fairy Kingdom~ For one day, nobody gets scolded no matter who pranks whom. Your queen would love it, right? The Church fairies… well, they'd get pranked a bit~
daily_shaydi_prank_day.reject: Please think of the Church's dignity too.

daily_espi_nightmares.title: A Nightmare Deal
daily_espi_nightmares.text: The fairies have been having nightmares lately, haven't they? I've been peeking a little. I could stop. But in exchange, Head Priestess, show me your dreams. I'm curious what dreams under the World Tree taste like.

daily_espi_masks.title: Masquerade Ball
daily_espi_masks.text: How about a masquerade ball for the festival? I'll make all the masks. My designs are perfect, you see. But don't let the caramel popcorn seller in. I can't stand that smell.
daily_espi_masks.reject: The popcorn seller is a fairy too.
daily_espi_masks.approve: The kingdom will pay for the masks.

daily_sist_credit.title: The Tab
daily_sist_credit.text: Ohh~ Boss! I want to take some goods from the fairy shops on credit, and all you need to do is vouch for me. Hehe. When I pay up, I'll add interest, plus some piping-hot gossip on top!

daily_sist_hideout.title: Hiding from the Ranking Battle
daily_sist_hideout.text: Ohh~ Boss, please hide me! A ranking battle broke out in the dragon caves, and I gave up early on. Hehe. But they keep calling me out. An attic room is all I need. I'll deliver gossip to Her Majesty every day!
daily_sist_hideout.reject: I'd rather stay out of dragon business.

daily_diana_flood.title: The Flooded Forest
daily_diana_flood.text: Head Priestess, the heavy rain has flooded the beastfolk forest. The little ones are soaked and shivering. Could you lend us a corner of the Fairy Kingdom, just until the water goes down? This old woman begs you.
daily_diana_flood.approve: We'll give you the space beside the Church storehouse.

daily_goldie_monatium25.title: Monatium25, Fairy Kingdom Branch
daily_goldie_monatium25.text: Hello, valued customer! I'm Goldie, owner of Monatium25. I'd like to open a branch in the Fairy Kingdom too. Open day and night, and only genuine candy on the shelves. The local candy shops might feel a little put out, though.
daily_goldie_monatium25.reject: We have to protect the local shops.

daily_goldie_realty.title: Goldie Realty
daily_goldie_realty.text: Valued customer, this is Goldie Realty. We'll rebuild the old houses in the eastern village for you. Genuine materials only. We'll pay a generous price for the land, too. The fairies will just have to move out for a little while during construction.
daily_goldie_realty.reject: The fairies will fix their own homes.

daily_goldie_jewels.title: Appraising the Crown Jewels
daily_goldie_jewels.text: Valued customer, I hear the kingdom's stores are running low. I'll buy the old jewels in the royal jewel box at genuine market price. No tricks. I only deal in genuine goods. Her Majesty might be a little sad, though.
daily_goldie_jewels.reject: We can't sell Her Majesty's jewels.

daily_fricle_tasting.title: Free Tasting of a New Potion
daily_fricle_tasting.text: Head Priestess of the Fairy Kingdom. I'll hold a tasting of the Witch Kingdom's new 'Sweet Dreams Potion.' Free. It's rare for me to be this kind, so accept it gratefully. Side effects? It's all in the fine print at the bottom of the contract.
daily_fricle_tasting.reject: I think I know what the fine print says without reading it.

daily_fricle_contract.title: Reviewing the Contract
daily_fricle_contract.text: Head Priestess of the Fairy Kingdom. Your contract with Monatium is a mess. I'll fix it for you. Witch Kingdom contracts are airtight. But my signature goes on it, not your little queen's. Can that brat even read a contract?

daily_monatium_trial.title: Free Trial: Refrigerated Display Cases
daily_monatium_trial.text: This is Monatium Sales. We'll install a refrigerated display case in every candy shop in the Fairy Kingdom, free. The candy won't melt, so it sells for longer. Once the trial ends, a modest usage fee applies. Very modest, of course.
daily_monatium_trial.reject: Our candy sells before it melts.

daily_monatium_tour.title: World Tree Tour Package
daily_monatium_tour.text: This is the Monatium Travel Division. A group of elf tourists would like to see inside the World Tree. We'll pay a generous entry fee. And please look the other way if they pluck a few leaves as souvenirs.
daily_monatium_tour.reject: The World Tree is not a sightseeing spot.
daily_monatium_tour.approve: Only up to the inner door.

daily_monatium_ads.title: Ads on the Palace Wall
daily_monatium_ads.text: This is Monatium Public Relations. The palace wall really catches the eye. Let us hang a billboard for our new products, and we'll pay a handsome advertising fee. It may end up a little bigger than Her Majesty's face.
daily_monatium_ads.reject: The palace is not a billboard.

daily_erpin_gadget.title: A Crystal Ball for Every Fairy
daily_erpin_gadget.text: Ner! Did you see Monatium's crystal balls? You can see someone's face and talk to them even when they're far away! Let's give one to every fairy in the kingdom. Then everyone will love me super much, right? And prayers… they can just do them by crystal ball.
daily_erpin_gadget.reject: The kingdom's candy would never last.

daily_sweetshop_tariff.title: Here Come the Factory Candies
daily_sweetshop_tariff.text: Head Priestess, Monatium factory candy is flooding the market, and not a single piece of ours is selling! Please put a tax on elf candy. Otherwise every candy shop will close.
daily_sweetshop_tariff.approve: We'll put a tax on elf candy.

daily_church_tree_lights.title: Night Lights for the World Tree
daily_church_tree_lights.text: Head Priestess, Monatium offers to light up the World Tree all night during the festival. The fairies are already excited. Only, they say the light strings must be wound around every branch of the World Tree. And we pay the electricity bill.
daily_church_tree_lights.reject: Starlight is enough for the World Tree.

fixed_bigwood_harvest.title: First Fruit
fixed_bigwood_harvest.text: Fruit… has grown… Head Priestess… are you… picking Bigwood's fruit…? Good! Pick more… pick it all, roughly…! Into the storehouse… or out to the fairies…
fixed_bigwood_harvest.reject: I'll put it in the storehouse.

fixed_sist_credit_due.title: Settling the Tab
fixed_sist_credit_due.text: Hehe… Boss, about my tab. I'll pay half in candy! The other half… could I pay it off as your informant, bringing you piping-hot gossip fast? Say, three times?
fixed_sist_credit_due.reject: The kingdom has its own tab to pay the villagers.

fixed_fricle_side_effect.title: The Nodding Village
fixed_fricle_side_effect.text: Head Priestess, the fairies who drank the Sweet Dreams Potion keep nodding off even in broad daylight. The fields and the shops have all stopped. Lady Fricle says she sells an antidote. Not for free.
fixed_fricle_side_effect.reject: Let's wait until they wake up on their own.

fixed_goldie_housewarming.title: Housewarming
fixed_goldie_housewarming.text: Valued customer, the new houses in the eastern village are all finished! With bigger homes, the fairies want to invite lots of guests. How about the kingdom throwing them a housewarming party? I'll pick out the decorations myself, genuine goods only.

fixed_monatium_subscription.title: Trial Period Over
fixed_monatium_subscription.text: This is Monatium Sales. The trial period for the refrigerated display cases has ended. Here is your bill for the usage fee. If you cancel, we'll collect the cases and charge a small cancellation fee. Very small, of course.

daily_kyarot_bumper_crop.title: Overflowing Sugarcane
daily_kyarot_bumper_crop.text: Head Priestess! The sugarcane grew like crazy this year! The storehouse is already full, and half of it is still in the field. Should I harvest it all? Or give some to the fairies?

daily_monatium_surplus_sugar.title: Surplus Sugar
daily_monatium_surplus_sugar.text: This is the Monatium Sugar Supply Division. The factory is producing so much sugar we're out of storage. We'll sell it to the Fairy Kingdom dirt cheap. Very cheap, of course.

daily_villager_assembly.title: Village Meeting
daily_villager_assembly.text: Head Priestess, there's talk among the fairies lately that village matters should be decided at village meetings. Without Her Majesty's say-so. Could you give us a meeting hall?
daily_villager_assembly.reject: We'll set up a suggestion box, that's all.

daily_erpin_gift_return.title: Birthday Thank-You Party
daily_erpin_gift_return.text: Ner! The fairies gave me a ton of presents for my birthday. I want to thank them back! Let's throw a party for everyone with the kingdom's candy. Big! Super big!

daily_church_night_vigil.title: All-Night Prayer
daily_church_night_vigil.text: Head Priestess, fairies are gathering to pray all night under the World Tree. Their devotion is touching… but they'll all be nodding off by day. Shall we keep it open all night?

daily_church_pilgrimage.title: The Growing Pilgrimage
daily_church_pilgrimage.text: Head Priestess, the pilgrimage to the World Tree grows longer every year. This year, half the fairies in the kingdom want to join. Shall we let it grow?

daily_erpin_decrees.title: Ten Decrees
daily_erpin_decrees.text: Ner! I'm writing ten decrees today. Double snack time, no homework, and everyone naps together on rainy days! I'm the queen, so I can do it all, right?

daily_erpin_shiny_crown.title: A New Crown
daily_erpin_shiny_crown.text: Ner, I saw a sparkly new crown in Monatium! My crown's way too old now. Let's get just one made, okay?
daily_erpin_shiny_crown.reject: Let's polish the one you have.

bishop_bigwood_heavy_fruit.title: Bent Branches
bishop_bigwood_heavy_fruit.text: Too much… fruit… has grown… The branches bend… and creak… It hurts… Good…! But if it all falls… it will rot on the ground… Head Priestess… will you pick it…? Into the storehouse… or into the fairies' mouths… Bigwood likes both…
bishop_bigwood_heavy_fruit.reject: Share it out as snacks for the fairies.
bishop_bigwood_heavy_fruit.approve: We'll pick it all for the storehouse.

bishop_kyarot_giant_cane.title: King Cane
bishop_kyarot_giant_cane.text: Head Priestess! Look at this! One cane stalk is three times taller than me! Not as good as a carrot… but it's super sweet! Boil down just this one and it'll fill a whole shelf of the storehouse. Or should we stand it in the square and all nibble on it together?
bishop_kyarot_giant_cane.reject: Let's all eat it in the square.
bishop_kyarot_giant_cane.approve: Boil it down for the storehouse.

bishop_villager_flea_market.title: Square Flea Market
bishop_villager_flea_market.text: Head Priestess, the fairies want to hold a flea market in the square. Old ribbons, empty candy tins, even half-eaten cookies! If the Church takes a small stall fee, it'll help the storehouse too. If it doesn't, everyone will be even happier, though.
bishop_villager_flea_market.reject: Open it with no stall fee.
bishop_villager_flea_market.approve: We'll take just a small fee.

bishop_erpin_belita_box.title: Big Sister's Candy Box
bishop_erpin_belita_box.text: Ner! I found a candy box my sister hid in the palace attic! It's huge! It's all mine, right? If it's my sister's, it's her little sister's, so it's mine, right? …You're going to say put it in the storehouse, aren't you? Aren't you? I can see it on your face!
bishop_erpin_belita_box.approve: It goes into the royal storehouse.

bishop_villager_back_taxes.title: Back Taxes
bishop_villager_back_taxes.text: Head Priestess, the fairies whose shops did well this year want to pay all their back taxes at once. In candy! But the other fairies are muttering, 'Does that mean we have to pay too?'
bishop_villager_back_taxes.reject: Tell them to keep it this year.

bishop_villager_flower_born.title: Little Evacuees
bishop_villager_flower_born.text: Head Priestess, a village across the river was flooded by heavy rain, and its young fairies have fled to us! More than twenty! They're all crying because they're hungry. Shall the Church look after them, or shall we hand them out to the villages?
bishop_villager_flower_born.reject: Hand them out to the villages.
bishop_villager_flower_born.approve: The Church will look after them.

bishop_sylla_council_invite.title: Spirit Council Invitation
bishop_sylla_council_invite.text: I've invited the Fairy Kingdom's Head Priestess to this spirit council. It's only fair to hear from the side that tends the World Tree. I'd like you to come. Otherwise I'll judge you with the wind. …Ah, no. You don't have to come. Just come.
bishop_sylla_council_invite.reject: I'll send my greetings by letter.

bishop_shaydi_masquerade.title: Ghost Swamp Parade
bishop_shaydi_masquerade.text: The Ghost Swamp gang and I are doing a costume parade~ One lap around the Fairy Kingdom square. Everyone will think we're fairies dressed as ghosts, so nobody will be scared, right? Probably~ Let us knock on doors for candy too, at least.

bishop_church_nap_contest.title: Nap Contest Under the World Tree
bishop_church_nap_contest.text: Head Priestess, the faithful want to hold a nap contest under the World Tree. Whoever sleeps longest and deepest wins. Since the Church's prayer is the nap, they say no contest could be more devout. Only, the fields will be empty that day.

boss_snow_road.title: Roads Buried in Snow
boss_snow_road.text: Reporting. The road in front of the palace is buried in snow, and the guard alone isn't enough. Shall we call out the village fairies, or send the Church's priests?

boss_snow_storehouse.title: The Collapsed Candy Storehouse
boss_snow_storehouse.text: Head Priestess, the candy storehouse roof caved in under the snow! If we dig now, we can save half of it. But everyone would have to stay up all night.
boss_snow_storehouse.reject: Don't push yourselves. We'll dig at daybreak.
boss_snow_storehouse.approve: Let's dig now. Thank you, everyone.

boss_snow_shelter.title: Freezing Fairies
boss_snow_shelter.text: Head Priestess, the fairies whose roofs broke are shivering in the cold. Shall we open the chapel and let them sleep there? Then there will be no services for a while.
boss_snow_shelter.reject: Have the neighbours take them in.

boss_sugar_cut.title: Supply Cut
boss_sugar_cut.text: This is the Monatium Sugar Supply Division. As of today, all sugar shipments to the Fairy Kingdom are suspended. Regulations do not permit us to disclose the reason. Objections… will not be accepted.
boss_sugar_cut.reject: Cut the palace's share first. Lock the storehouse.
boss_sugar_cut.approve: Open the storehouse and share it out.

boss_sugar_rebellion.title: Sugar Rebellion
boss_sugar_rebellion.text: Rebellion! The bread's gone and the sugar's gone! Even the guards have run off! Kingdom, bring back our sugar! Down with the queen!
boss_sugar_rebellion.reject: Throw all the candy we have left into the square!
boss_sugar_rebellion.approve: Your Majesty, take my hand. Run!
